content_feed.telegram_post: 📜 #ORDER_WIN | Highway Infrastructure Limited (NSE: HILINFRA) Highway Infrastructure Limited Secures Rs. 24.46 Crore Toll Operations Contract ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Contract Value: Rs. 24.46 crore - Location: Velanchettiyur Fee Plaza, NH‑7, Tamil Nadu - Duration: 90 days - Client: NHAI 📌 What happened: ↳ HIL received a Letter of Acceptance from NHAI to operate and collect tolls at Velanchettiyur Fee Plaza, adding Rs. 24.46 crore to its order book. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing

content_feed.headline: Studds Accessories to Commence Commercial Production at Facility‑V by End of Oct 2026
content_feed.worthiness_reason: Capacity expansion with new production expected.

content_feed.headline: Unimech Aerospace completes first tranche of capital infusion into Kanoo Unimech Advanced Manufacturing Solutions JV
content_feed.worthiness_reason: First tranche capital infusion into JV disclosed.
content_feed.telegram_post: 🤝 JOINT_VENTURE | Unimech Aerospace and Manufacturing Limited (NSE: UNIMECH) Unimech Aerospace completes first tranche of capital infusion into Kanoo Unimech Advanced Manufacturing Solutions JV ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - First tranche capital infusion: SAR 15.30 million (≈Rs 39.35 crore) - Unimech stake: 51% (controlling) - Kanoo stake: 49% - Second tranche: SAR 30 million to be infused later - JV authorized share capital: SAR 60 million 📌 What happened: ↳ Unimech Aerospace has completed its first tranche of capital infusion into the joint venture, securing a controlling 51% stake. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing
